summary: Patient missed the appointment because she forgot and received no reminder. She wishes to reschedule for next week.
recommended_action: Reschedule the patient's appointment for next week and verify her SMS/email reminder preferences in the EHR.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to living far from the clinic and lacking available transportation that morning.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or provide resources for local patient transportation services.

summary: Patient skipped the appointment due to high consultation fees and inquired about follow-up discounts.
recommended_action: Inform the patient about available financial assistance, payment plans, or follow-up discount options before rescheduling.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a high fever and body aches, opting to stay in bed until recovered.
recommended_action: Follow up in 2-3 days to check recovery status and reschedule the appointment.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to an urgent mandatory work meeting and requested an evening appointment.
recommended_action: Reschedule patient into an evening time slot as requested.

summary: Patient missed appointment because they forgot and did not receive an SMS reminder. Requested a new booking.
recommended_action: Reschedule the patient appointment and verify SMS notification settings in the system.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of local transport options, making distance an issue.
recommended_action: Assist patient in rescheduling and offer options for telehealth or transportation support services if available.

summary: Unable to reach patient after three call attempts because their phone was switched off.
recommended_action: Send an automated text message or email asking the patient to call back and reschedule.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a factory shift change and requested Saturday appointments instead.
recommended_action: Reschedule the patient for an available Saturday slot.
